verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs say scanned receipts match card transactions automatically, with no manual matching or duplicates (docs-28). They also say digital receipts are imported automatically from integrations like Uber and handled the same way as paper scans (docs-29). Nothing in the pack covers targeted nudges that fire only when a receipt is genuinely missing, and all support is vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: evidence of missing-receipt notifications that fire only when a receipt is actually absent, detail on which e-receipt integrations exist beyond Uber, and independent or hands-on confirmation that auto-matching works reliably.
